 Order

Accused in Crime No.94/2024 registered by the Lingasugur Police Station, Raichur for the offences punishable under Sections 363 and 376 of IPC and Sections 4 and 6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act is before this Court under Section 439 of Cr.P.C., seeking regular bail.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
Respondent No.2 is served in the matter has remained unrepresented before this Court.

3. FIR in Crime No.94/2024 was registered by the Lingasugur Police Station, Raichur initially for the offence punishable under Section 363 of IPC against unknown NC: 2024:KHC-K:4897 persons on the basis of the first information dated 03.04.2024 received from the second respondent herein who is the father of the victim girl.
During the course of investigation the victim girl and the petitioner were traced together in Goa on 20.04.2024 and brought back to their village.

Thereafter,
the petitioner was produced before the jurisdictional Court and remanded to judicial custody.
Investigation in the case is completed and charge-sheet is filed.
Bail application filed by the petitioner before the jurisdictional Sessions Court in Crl.Msic.No.5160/2024 was rejected on 20.05.2024.
Therefore, he is before this Court 4.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is a youngster, aged about 22 years and he is in custody 21.04.2024.
Victim girl who is aged bout 17 years had voluntarily accompanied the petitioner since she was being harassed in her house by her parents.

He submits that victim has not made any allegation against the petitioner in her statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C., He accordingly prays to allow the petition.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Per contra, learned High Court Government Pleader for respondent/State has opposed the petition.
He submits that the victim girl is a minor, studying in I PUC and there are allegations of sexual assault against the petitioner.
Accordingly, prays to dismiss the petition.
6. The first informant had approached the police on 03.04.2024 after the victim girl was found missing from the house on 02.04.2024.
In the first information, it is averred that the victim girl who was studying in I PUC had left the house on the intervening night of 02.04.2024 and 03.04.2024 at about 12.30 a.m.
During the course of investigation, the petitioner and the victim girl were traced together in Goa and brought back.

In her statement under Section 164 of Cr.P.C., recorded by the jurisdictional Magistrate on 20.04.2024, the victim girl has stated that she is in love with the petitioner and after her parents learnt about the same, they were assaulting her.
She has also stated that attempts were made by her parents to get her married to some other boy.

It is in this background, NC: 2024:KHC-K:4897 she had voluntarily left her house and had gone with the petitioner on the night of 02.04.2024 from Shahapur to Goa and they had stayed together in Goa till the police traced them on 19.04.2024 and brought them back to Lingasugur.
She has not made any allegation of sexual assault by the petitioner.
Petitioner is aged about 22 years and he is in custody from 21.04.2024.
Investigation in the case is completed and charge-sheet has been filed.
Under the circumstances, I am of the opinion that the prayer made by the petitioner for grant of regular bail is required to be answered affirmatively.

Accordingly, the following order :
The petition is allowed.
